mapper.sql: brands.id AS id, brands.name AS name, brands.is_active AS isActive, brands.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, brands.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM brands LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = brands.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = brands.modified_by

WHERE brands.is_active = 1
AND brands.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO brands ( name, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{productBrand.name}, NOW(), #{productBrand.createdBy}, #{productBrand.isActive} )
